flags.why: The established sports meaning is a drop shot or soft tip near the net, rather than a short football pass ([textbook](https://www.sachgiaokhoa.online/lop-12-15/ket-noi-tri-thuc-voi-cuoc-song-3/phan-ii-chu-de-2-ki-thuat-bo-nho-3381/bai-1-ki-thuat-bo-nho-cheo-thuan-tay-12441.html)).
flags.fix: to play a drop shot (badminton or tennis); to tip the ball softly over the net (volleyball)

flags.why: The football example does not demonstrate the established meaning of playing a soft shot near the net.
flags.fix: Anh ấy bỏ nhỏ khiến đối thủ không kịp lên lưới. = He played a drop shot that his opponent could not reach in time.

flags.why: Scoring a quick football goal is not a meaning of bỏ nhỏ.

Bốn bể does not designate the Pacific, Indian, Atlantic and Arctic oceans; its literal origin is the ancient four seas already covered by sense 3 ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%E1%BB%91n%20b%E1%BB%83)).
flags.fix: Remove sense 2 and retain the historical four-seas meaning in sense 3.
